title: Security deposit

source.quote: The Licensee shall pay to the Licensor an interest-free refundable security deposit of Rs. 1,50,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Fifty Thousand only)

plain_explanation.text: You pay a deposit of ₹1,50,000 before moving in. No interest is paid on it.

citations.quote: The Licensee shall pay to the Licensor an interest-free refundable security deposit of Rs. 1,50,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Fifty Thousand only)

stated: The deposit is interest-free and refundable.
It is refunded within 30 days of vacating, after deductions.

interpretations.text: 'Damages' and 'painting charges' are not defined, so the amount that can be deducted is unclear.
